# בית בסדר (Bayit Beseder)

> אפליקציה חינמית בעברית לניהול משק הבית — לזוגות, משפחות ושותפים.
> Free Hebrew-first home management app for couples, families, and roommates.

## What it does

- Smart chore rotation and task management with gamification (points, streaks, achievements)
- Weekly planning algorithm that splits tasks by home zone, day, and load
- Shared shopping list with 22 categories and realtime sync
- WhatsApp daily summaries and Google Calendar integration
- Passover (Pesach) mode with a 37-task, 4-stage checklist
- PWA — works straight from the browser, installable on mobile

- https://www.bayitbeseder.com/blog — home management tips (Hebrew)
- https://www.bayitbeseder.com/contact — contact
- https://www.bayitbeseder.com/privacy — privacy policy
- https://www.bayitbeseder.com/terms — terms of service

## Facts

- Language: Hebrew (RTL), free to use, no premium tier
- Open source: https://github.com/eladjak/bayit-beseder
- Tech: Next.js, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, hosted on Vercel
- Contact: contact@bayitbeseder.com
